title: The Market Sucks. These 2 Don’t. I’m Buying BOTH Right Now
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Index strength is mega-cap driven; equal-weight RSP has been rolling over for 5-6 weeks.
Bond market falling apart; the 30-year yield is the highest since 2002, making stocks less attractive.
Consistent net new 52-week lows for the first time in 2026 and % above the 200-day collapsed to ~50%; he is trading lighter and being picky.
Memory and storage stocks lead on all time frames, driven by agentic AI demand.

calls.reason: Clean multi-month consolidation pushing out the top side after a big run, similar to the April breakout; leading memory group.
calls.quote: I'm long from 1045. It's currently sitting at 1071

calls.reason: After a 60% correction from 2,400 to ~1,000, shallower pullbacks and tightening consolidation set up another breakout.
calls.quote: So I went ahead and bought SanDisk here as well. SNDK. I'm long from what does it say I bought at 1716.

calls.condition: If inflation cools, the Iran situation resolves and oil falls, stocks would soar.
calls.reason: Breadth indicators unhealthy and momentum not long; similar washout earlier in the year was the best buy point but he is not calling a bottom.
calls.quote: I'm just saying the momentum is currently not long.

notes: Date stated by host ('as of today, September 29th'); trades placed minutes before recording, during market hours. SNDK target is 'about 30%' above entry 'on a tap of these highs' (~2,230 if 30%, prior high ~2,400); target left null because no exact level given, and he would likely sell half there and trail the rest.
